routes.name: Myanmar Tourist eVisa
routes.summary: Tourist eVisa applied for on the official portal. It is only valid for selected ports of entry.

other: Fee, stay length and nationality rules not confirmed on the pages read.
eVisa works only at selected ports of entry listed on the portal.

steps: Apply on the official eVisa portal.

routes.name: Myanmar Business eVisa
routes.summary: Business eVisa from the official portal. It is the entry visa needed before you can apply for a stay extension.

other: Fee and stay length not confirmed on the pages read.

routes.name: Business eVisa Stay Extension and Re-entry Visa
routes.summary: People living and working in Myanmar can extend their stay for 3, 6 or 12 months online, and add a re-entry visa.

other: Latest entry visa must be a Business eVisa from the official portal.
Passport needs at least six months validity.

routes.processing: About five working days after receipt is acknowledged, per the official FAQ. You pay only after approval.
